Accessibility Statement

Our Commitment to Accessibility

At Cut and Taste Las Vegas, we are committed to making our digital and physical spaces inclusive and accessible to everyone, including people with disabilities. We believe in providing an equitable experience to all guests, and we continually strive to improve the usability of our website and services.

Guidelines and Conformance

As part of our ongoing efforts, we are actively working toward following and conforming to the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2, at the Level AA standard. These guidelines explain how to make web content more accessible to people with a wide range of disabilities. By following these guidelines, we aim to ensure our website is usable by all individuals.

Contact Us & Feedback

We are continually seeking to improve the accessibility of our website and services. If you experience any difficulty accessing our website, have trouble reading our menus, or require assistance with any other aspect of our services, please let us know. We are here to help!
